# releaseverify fixture (generated)

Generated by the publisher's fixture generator (not part of the Core tree); do not edit by hand. Each case directory holds a tiny
evaluation ZIP (root `pail-evaluation/`, STORED members, 1980-01-01 timestamps), its manifest in the schema
the evaluation packaging tool writes, and an Ed25519 `.sig` over the manifest bytes. `cases.json`
lists the verifier arguments per case; `expected/<case>.stdout` and `.rc` are the stdout and exit code of
the evaluation bundle's `verify_evaluation.py` (python cryptography backend) with two rewrites, which the Go
verifier `cmd/pail_verify` must then reproduce byte for byte:

- the backend word after `VERIFIED key=...` becomes `pail_verify`;
- the `VERIFIER:` line (the Python tool reports whether it used the bundled verifier; the Go tool IS the bundled
  verifier) becomes the Go constant `VERIFIER: this is the bundled verifier (pail_verify)`.

The `tree-*` cases also hold `tree/`, the ZIP's members as extracted (the contents of `pail-evaluation/`), and
pass `--tree-root <case>/tree` (relative to this directory in `cases.json`; the Go test makes it absolute).
`tree-match` is the untouched extract, `tree-modified` has one member edited, one deleted and one file added,
`tree-dsstore-ignored` adds `.DS_Store` and `pail-core/__pycache__/x.pyc`, which the ignore list hides. All other
cases run without a tree root and print `TREE: not compared ...`.

**TEST-ONLY KEYS.** `TEST-SIGNING-KEY.pub` and `TEST-WRONG-KEY.pub` are derived from fixed seeds embedded in the
generator. They are public by construction and sign nothing that carries trust; they are not the publisher's
release key (see SECURITY.md for that fingerprint).
